title: Velsaro
summary: E-commerce store for an Indian attar house
role: Web developer: design, build and deploy
problem: A small-batch attar house selling saffron, sandalwood and jasmine fragrances needed a storefront that feels as considered as the product, with room for gifting, offers and the brand's story.
outcome: A live store at velsaro.in with shop, gifting, offers, a fragrance guide and an Our Story section, plus search, accounts, a wishlist and a cart. I also handle the domain, hosting and deploys.

title: Nexcart
problem: A storefront that has to sell one hero product properly, not just list it, while still working as a full shop.
outcome: A shop with Shop, Stories and About pages, search, accounts, a wishlist and a cart, led by a featured-product showcase with a spec grid and a pre-order call to action. Deployed on Vercel.

title: Synapical
summary: Studio site for a Delhi software studio
problem: Synapical is a small software studio in Delhi working across web, mobile, AI and cloud. Its site has to show that range and turn visitors into new projects.
outcome: I ship client-facing Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS work inside the studio's live production codebase, following the team's conventions on real client projects.

title: Attendo
problem: Students, faculty and admins all work with the same attendance records, but each should only see and change their own part of them.
outcome: Three production dashboards for students, faculty and admins, with auth and row-level security keeping each role to its own data. Lectures move through four states, from scheduled to cancelled, with present/absent marking and Zod-validated forms.

title: Rudo AI
role: Built the agent, its tools and memory
problem: A terminal assistant that can act on your machine without a cloud LLM, on an ordinary 16 GB laptop.
outcome: Streaming chat, voice in and out and persistent memory, with five tools (shell, files, search, notes, timer), five live system signals and RAG over notes, in an 8,192-token context on 16 GB of RAM.

title: Bunny OS
summary: Local voice assistant for Windows and macOS
role: Built and released the desktop app
problem: Most voice assistants send what you say to the cloud. Bunny OS had to run entirely on your own machine and still be safe to let act on it.
outcome: Shipped v0.3.4 as a Windows MSI and a macOS DMG. Speech and inference run 100% locally through faster-whisper and Ollama, with no cloud APIs or telemetry, and risky actions wait for on-screen confirmation.

title: GetCited
summary: AEO & GEO website platform · NamasteDev Hackathon 2026 Top 17 winner
problem: AI assistants now answer questions themselves, so a site has to be easy for them to read and cite. Site owners had no way to tell how likely ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity or Copilot were to cite them.
outcome: A crawler and audit pipeline that returns two scores and a prioritised fix list across five layers: metadata, schema, HTML, crawlability and structured data, plus CLIP and DeepGaze saliency. A Top 17 winner at NamasteDev Hackathon 2026.
